children: French hospitality giant Accor and Dubai-based developer Cityview Developments have signed an agreement to launch Mövenpick Residences Dubai Motor City, marking the debut of the first standalone Mövenpick-branded residential project globally and the first branded residential development in Dubai Motor City community.
The 408-unit project is scheduled for completion and opening in 2028.
